title: Order, Continued-Use and Authorization Requirements — PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
The documentation the PAP Supply Replenishment Program requires on each resupply schedule is set by six settings: how many calendar months a written supply order stays usable, how many calendar months the latest proof of continued use stays sufficient, what counts as proof of continued use, whether an affirmed prior authorization covering supplies is needed and for how many calendar months it stays in force, and whether a device furnished by another supplier needs proof that it was covered or owned before enrollment.

## Requirements by schedule

| Schedule | Supply order usable for | Proof of continued use sufficient for | What counts as proof of continued use | Supplies prior authorization | Prior authorization in force for | Outside device needs proof of coverage or ownership |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medicare Part B Resupply Schedule | 12 months | 12 months | compliance data or a practitioner note | not required | 0 (none needed) | yes |
| Medicare Advantage Resupply Schedule | 12 months | 12 months | compliance data or a practitioner note | not required | 0 (none needed) | yes |
| Medicaid Resupply Schedule | 6 months | 6 months | a practitioner note only | required | 6 months | yes |
| Commercial HMO Resupply Schedule | 12 months | 12 months | compliance data only | not required | 0 (none needed) | yes |
| Commercial PPO Resupply Schedule | 12 months | 12 months | compliance data only | not required | 0 (none needed) | yes |
| Self-Pay Supply Subscription | 12 months | 0 (no proof needed) | none | not required | 0 (none needed) | no |

A proof-of-continued-use period of 0 means that no proof is needed; a prior-authorization period of 0 means that no authorization is needed. The proof an outside device needs is a purchase record or a prior supplier letter.

## Basis notes

- **Kinds of proof.** Three kinds of acceptance appear across the schedules: either compliance data or a practitioner note (both Medicare schedules), a practitioner note only (Medicaid), and compliance data only (both commercial schedules). The Self-Pay Supply Subscription accepts none because it needs none.
- **Medicaid.** The Medicaid Resupply Schedule is the only schedule with a 6-month order, a 6-month proof period and a required supplies prior authorization, which stays in force for 6 calendar months.
- **Outside devices.** Proof of coverage or ownership for a device furnished by another supplier is required on every schedule except the Self-Pay Supply Subscription.
